rules.comment: Variant of osmand-roundabout-pt one step above it (#134): bigText's first line is OsmAnd's instruction (route_roundabout_short 'Saia na %d saída para' / pt-BR 'Pegue a %dª saída e continue'), the street and the next step's distance. Road line: that line without the distance; compact: from the exit number on. Second line and ETA: the summary line's arrival clock.

From OsmAnd's instruction strings (res/values-pt and values-pt-rBR/strings.xml, 2026-10-04; #61, #57), which its notification shows verbatim. Synthetic until captured. \b only next to ASCII letters, so JVM, Android and workbench agree. Covers Portugal (values-pt) and Brazil (values-pt-rBR) wording.
